name: DraPri Guu-ta-life 3
source:
A few weeks have passed since the tumult of Iris, the Rainbow Dragon, leading her Sea Dragons to Earth to take over the world’s oceans. The dragons’ attitudes have softened since then. They no longer threaten to annihilate anyone who gets too close to the sea, for one. Humanity and dragonkind are beginning to adjust to a new world of coexistence.

Our story revolves around an unemployed protagonist dwelling in a run-down dojo in Nowhere, Japan, living his best life alongside an ever-growing entourage of dragon royalty. A casual observer would no doubt assume they’d been living this way for a decade or more, given how close they all are.

As the end of August approaches, the town shopping district is beginning preparations for a festival to mark the end of summer. This will be the first summer festival ever experienced by dragonkind. Meanwhile, for humanity (and one unfortunate girl in particular) this summer festival presents a once-in-a-lifetime chance to make special memories.

Yet unbeknownst to our protagonist, a shadow is looming.
"I cannot allow the likes of that human to deceive my Haru-chan! She’s the future of dragonkind!"

With that cry appears the big, bad Nether Princess Mei (hereafter, simply Mei.) The world now faces yet another threat. But that’s a story for later. Enjoying the festival comes first and foremost.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225250/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
彩虹龍伊莉絲率領海龍進軍地球、企圖統治全球海洋的風波已過去數週。龍族的態度有所軟化，至少不會再威脅要消滅每一個靠近海洋的人類。人類與龍族開始適應共存的新世界。

故事圍繞一位失業主角展開。他住在日本偏僻小鎮的一間破舊道場裡，與人數愈來愈多的龍族王室成員一起過著悠閒日子。旁人看他們親密的模樣，大概會以為他們已經這樣生活了十多年。

八月底將至，鎮上的商店街開始籌備夏末祭典。這將是龍族首次體驗夏日祭典。與此同時，對人類而言——尤其是某位不幸的少女——這場祭典則是創造特別回憶、改變一生的機會。

然而，主角還不知道，一團陰影正悄然逼近。
「我絕不允許那種人類欺騙我的小春！她可是龍族的未來！」

隨著這聲怒吼登場的，是兇巴巴的冥派公主梅（以下簡稱小梅）。世界又一次面臨新的威脅。不過，那是之後的事了。眼下最重要的是享受祭典。
